note: Profile fits well: a senior commercial professional in clinical trial analytics who describes himself as a top performer, explicitly frames the purchase as identity-driven ('super successful people are never just content being a 7 or an 8'), and is a marathon runner rather than a deconditioned beginner — the exclusion criterion is comfortably cleared. Health is the neglected corner of an otherwise high-functioning life, which is exactly the stated case. He fails on income as tested by affordability: he rejected the offer twice on price without hesitation ('that's way out of my expectation', 'that's out of my range') and self-selected to a $200/mo product. Worth noting for the rollup that his ability to pay was never actually established — the rep ran no financial-picture questions — so 'income' here is a miss on demonstrated willingness rather than on evidenced capacity.
